title: eDNA Water Sample Collection, Preservation and Extraction
author: Eldridge Wisely
materials: QIAgen recommend storing DNA frozen ( -90 °C to -15 °C ) as Solution EB does not contain EDTA
Heat Solutions PW1 and PW3 to 55 °C and Buffer EB to 70 °C .

steps.title: Collect water sample
steps.instruction: Submerge a cleaned 1 L Nalgene bottle (Thermo Fisher N311‑1000BPC) in the water, open it underwater, close it, and retrieve the bottle, minimizing contact with skin, clothing or equipment.

steps.title: Record sample metadata
steps.instruction: Label the bottle and record latitude, longitude, water temperature and any other desired variables.

steps.title: Store sample on ice
steps.instruction: Place the labeled bottle in a cooler with ice packs, keep it protected from UV light and filter within 12 hours of collection.

steps.title: Clean reusable filter funnel
steps.instruction: Clean the reusable filter funnel and its support pedestal with 10 % bleach, then rinse three times with purified water (drinking water if available, otherwise tap water).

steps.title: Assemble filter unit
steps.instruction: Insert a 0.45 µm MCE filter into the cleaned reusable funnel and re‑assemble the unit.

steps.title: Filter water sample
steps.instruction: Pour the entire 1 L sample from the Nalgene bottle into the assembled filter unit while applying vacuum with a vacuum pump.

steps.title: Rinse filter
steps.instruction: Rinse the filter three times with purified water (drinking water if possible, otherwise tap water).

steps.title: Add DNA/RNA Shield
steps.instruction: Stop the vacuum, loosen the tubing to release pressure, add 500 µL DNA/RNA Shield (Zymo Research catalog #R1100‑50) to fully cover the filter, let sit for at least 5 seconds at room temperature, then briefly re‑apply vacuum until the liquid is pulled through.

steps.title: Expose filter membrane
steps.instruction: Remove the funnel portion of the reusable unit so the filter membrane is exposed.

steps.title: Wear gloves
steps.instruction: Put on lab gloves for all subsequent steps and change them if any contact with the sample water occurs.

steps.title: Transfer filter to tube
steps.instruction: Using two sets of sterile forceps (tweezers cleaned with bleach solution then 70 % EtOH and air‑dried), pick up the white filter membrane at opposite edges, roll it into a cylinder with the top side facing inward, and place it into a PowerWater DNA Bead Tube.

steps.title: Add PW1 solution
steps.instruction: Add 1 mL Solution PW1 to the PowerWater DNA Bead Tube.

steps.title: Vortex tube
steps.instruction: Secure the tube horizontally on a Qiagen vortex adapter for 5 mL tubes (catalog 13000‑V1‑5) and vortex at maximum speed for 5 minutes (00:05:00).

steps.title: Collect supernatant
steps.instruction: Draw the supernatant with a 1 mL pipette tip, placing the tip down into the beads, and transfer it to a clean 2 mL collection tube; expect to recover 650–800 µL.

steps.title: First centrifugation
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the tube at 13 000 × g, room temperature, for 1 minute.

steps.title: Add IRS solution
steps.instruction: Avoiding the pellet, transfer the supernatant to a new clean 2 mL collection tube, add 200 µL Solution IRS, vortex briefly, and incubate at 2–8 °C for 5 minutes (00:05:00).

steps.title: Second centrifugation
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 13 000 × g, room temperature, for 1 minute.

steps.title: Add PW3 solution
steps.instruction: Avoiding the pellet, transfer the supernatant to another clean 2 mL collection tube, add 650 µL Solution PW3, and mix thoroughly by pipetting or brief vortex.

steps.title: Load spin column
steps.instruction: Load 650 µL of the supernatant onto an MB Spin Column, centrifuge at 13 000 × g, room temperature, for 1 minute, discard the flow‑through, and repeat until all supernatant has been processed.

steps.title: PW4 wash
steps.instruction: Place the MB Spin Column filter into a clean 2 mL collection tube, add 650 µL Solution PW4 (shaken before use), centrifuge at 13 000 × g, room temperature, for 1 minute, then discard the flow‑through.

steps.title: Ethanol wash
steps.instruction: Add 650 µL ethanol (provided) to the column, centrifuge at 13 000 × g, room temperature, for 1 minute, discard the flow‑through, then centrifuge again at 13 000 × g, room temperature, for 2 minutes.

steps.title: Elution
steps.instruction: Place the MB Spin Column into a clean 2 mL collection tube, add 100 µL of 70 °C Solution EB to the center of the white filter membrane, centrifuge at 13 000 × g, room temperature, for 1 minute, discard the column, and transfer the eluate to a new 1.5 mL DNAse‑/RNA‑free sterile tube (Axygen MCT150CS).

steps.title: Eluate incubation
steps.instruction: Incubate the eluate at room temperature for a minimum of 10 minutes (00:10:00).

steps.title: Prepare negative controls
steps.instruction: Take 1 L of rinse water as a laboratory negative control and process it through the entire protocol; also prepare a field negative control by leaving rinse water in a cleaned Nalgene bottle, transporting it with the field samples, and handling it identically except that the water is not changed.

steps.title: Clean sample bottle
steps.instruction: After use, clean the 1 L Nalgene bottle with 10 % bleach, rinse three times with purified water, and retain at least one rinse‑water negative control as described in the previous step.

steps.title: Repeat for additional liters
steps.instruction: For each additional liter of water to be processed, repeat steps starting from “Filter water sample”.
